scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\prepare-dev.ps1 && scripts\go-local.bat -C backend build -o dist/gank-api.exe ./cmd/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "backend\dist\gank-api.exe" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: scripts\go-local.bat -C backend build -o dist/gank-api.exe ./cmd/server && npm run build -w frontend
